title: Synthesis and Properties of Novel Polyimide Fibers Containing Phosphorus Groups in the Side Chain (DATPPO)
sample_state: PI-0, DATPPO:ODA 0:10, draft 3.0 and draw 1.6, initial PI fibers
washing_state: As-prepared fibers after the process washing bath; no durability laundering reported
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Table 2: Thermal behaviors of the PI fibers; footnote b specifies weight retention of the fibers at 850 °C under N2.
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Table 2 footnote d: values measured by oxygen index meter; adjacent prose identifies the same PI fibers.
treatment_chemistry: Table 1 and Table 2: DATPPO:ODA molar ratio 0:10, with stoichiometric s-BPDA. DATPPO is [2,5-bis(4-aminophenoxy)phenyl] diphenylphosphine oxide; PI-0 is the ODA/s-BPDA control.
treatment_method: s-BPDA dried overnight under vacuum at 260 °C. DATPPO and ODA reacted with a stoichiometric quantity of s-BPDA in DMAc under nitrogen at room temperature for 24 h; solids 15 wt% of total solution. PAA solution filtered and degassed, then dry-jet wet spun through a 50-hole spinneret of 0.12 mm hole diameter into water/DMAc 42:58 by volume. Filaments passed a washing bath and heating oven and were collected on winders. PAA fibers heated to 300 °C to form PI fibers, followed by drawing. Table 1 assigns the unprimed PI-0 through PI-6 series draft ratio 3.0 and draw ratio 1.6; draw temperature and residence time are not stated. DATPPO monomer synthesis is documented in the official three-page SI; no durability laundering is reported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Aliquot of the prepared PI fiber state; no aliquot mass, pan, cutting or grinding, or TG preconditioning reported.
LOI_instrument: HC-2C oxygen index meter, Jingning Analysis Instrument Company, China
LOI_locator: Published p.378, PDF p.7, Table 2 column LOI d and footnote d; adjacent paragraph explicitly distinguishes measured and calculated LOI.
TG_locator: Published p.378, PDF p.7, Table 2 T5, T10 and CR columns, footnotes a and b.
conditions_locator: Published pp.373–375, PDF pp.2–4, preparation and Table 1; p.376, PDF p.5, Characterization; official SI pp.1–3.
pairing_evidence: Table 2 contains both TG quantities and measured LOI on the same PI-0 row and DATPPO:ODA ratio 0:10. Table 1 maps this unprimed label to draft 3.0 and draw 1.6 and distinguishes PI-6 prime and double-prime. Both measurements concern the prepared PI fibers.
source_access_method: Complete original official journal PDF downloaded, 14 pages, with Table 1, Table 2 and methods checked against rendered page pixels; official Springer three-page SI downloaded and reviewed.
limitations: LOI is the measured Table 2 column d, supported by the HC-2C instrument and the adjacent experimental-LOI prose. Column c is calculated from char yield by the van Krevelen equation and is excluded. LOI standard, geometry or mounting, conditioning, replicate count and uncertainty are not reported. The at least 10 filaments and GB/T 14337 apply only to tensile testing, and the aluminum pan applies only to DSC; neither is assigned to TG or LOI. TG aliquot mass, pan, gas flow and cutting or grinding are not reported. Figure 3 displays 400–850 °C, whereas the method explicitly states acquisition from 30–850 °C. The approximate derivative regions near 550 and 600 °C are not extracted as exact Tmax values. PI-6 prime and double-prime draw variants have mechanical data only and receive no TG/LOI transfer. Related main-chain DAMPO source 10.1039/c6ra02344d uses a different monomer and draft ratio 3.8; its control TG tuple differs and its methods do not report an LOI assay. Related AO source 10.1039/c6ra26941a uses the same DATPPO family: pre-exposure states require future reuse review, and no AO-exposed state is assigned these initial measurements.

source_metric_holds: Calculated LOI column c and approximate DTG regions excluded; extra mechanical draw states have no measured TG/LOI pairs.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Exact original Table 2 values; only the separately measured oxygen-meter LOI column d is canonical.
